summary: Frontend Software Developer with 4 years of UK experience building and maintaining production mobile and web applications. Specialise in cross-platform Ionic apps for iOS/Android and scalable Next.js applications with TypeScript. Comfortable working autonomously, owning application lifecycles from requirements and architecture through deployment and maintenance.

items: Build and evolve a scalable Next.js 16 dashboard platform using Prisma ORM and MariaDB, integrating Business Central ERP with internal systems.
Established core platform foundations including authentication, token rotation, permissions, multi-company context, internationalisation, theming, caching, and reusable npm workspace packages.
Own and maintain 3 production Ionic apps published on iOS and Android: 2 B2B apps built on a shared architecture with business-specific workflows, and 1 B2C dropshipping app.
Deliver mobile features with Ionic 8, Capacitor 8, React 19, and TypeScript, including barcode scanning, REST API integration, and Firebase push notifications.
Maintain and extend an internal barcode generation app, ensuring unique product barcode assignment with validation to prevent duplicates and protect inventory accuracy.
Improve app reliability through Sentry error tracking, Firebase Analytics, and Cypress E2E test coverage across key user flows.
Delivered small-scale websites and IT services for local businesses.
Built and maintained WordPress websites and plugins, handling both frontend and backend tasks.
Built e-commerce and corporate websites with WordPress, WooCommerce, and custom plugins.
Provided IT support and troubleshooting for local clients.
